verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a full REST/OpenAPI surface, HogQL, CLI, and an official MCP server letting agents run trends/funnels/retention/SQL, ship feature flags, and inspect stack traces (posthog-probe-3, posthog-docs-2/19/24/20), suggesting broad API/agent parity with the UI. However, hands-on community feedback reports the AI/LLM integration failing basic tasks (e.g., could not create a SQL-based cohort) and causing severe client performance issues, undercutting the claimed seamless API/agent experience.
